memberdef.definition: cl::opt< bool > EnablePrecomputePhysRegs("precompute-phys-liveness", cl::Hidden, cl::desc("Eagerly compute live intervals for all physreg units."))
memberdef.argsstring: ("precompute-phys-liveness", cl::Hidden, cl::desc("Eagerly compute live intervals for all physreg units."))
memberdef.name: EnablePrecomputePhysRegs

briefdescription.para: Check whether use of reg in MI is live-through.

detaileddescription.para: Live-through means that the value is alive on exit from Machine instruction. The example of such use is a deopt value in statepoint instruction.
